People around Sam often share different ideas about the city park. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. What's more, the roses come out in early summer.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. At first, Sam found it difficult to keep the habit. Max advised Sam to try singing as a new hobby. In fact, waders probe the mudflat for worms.

The river bank has become an important part of daily life. Little by little, things began to change. Sam wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The hikers walked perilously close to the cliff edge.

Sam bought a hat online because it was much cheaper. Max and Sam are preparing a report about the city park. The experience taught Sam more than any book could. For example, seals bask on the sandbanks of the firth at low tide.
Sam thanked Max for the honest advice. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The city park looked quieter than usual that evening.
